Witty editorial advertising still life, 4:5 vertical frame, for an Indian demi-fine jewellery brand. On a pale ivory lime-plaster surface, half a pomegranate lies cut face up at the upper right edge of the frame, its glistening deep-red arils packed in white pith; seven loose arils have rolled out across the plaster. ONE single ruby baguette tennis bracelet, CLOSED with its box clasp shut, lies as ONE continuous unbroken oval loop in the lower middle, the loose arils around it, its stones exactly the same deep red as the seeds.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved product photograph and the authority on this exact piece: its construction, size, metal colour and stone colour; ignore its plaster cube, background and light. IMAGE 2 is the supplier photograph of the same piece, for construction detail only; ignore everything else in it. Preserve the piece exactly: do not redesign, restyle, resize or add anything. CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A TENNIS BRACELET: ONE continuous line of deep RUBY-RED rectangular BAGUETTE stones set CROSSWISE, side by side like the rungs of a ladder, each stone held by gold claws at its four corners, edge to edge with no gaps, about 5mm wide; a gold box clasp with a fold-over safety tongue. Warm 18k gold tone. The stones stay rectangular baguettes set crosswise, never round, never set lengthways; all stones ruby red, never pink, never orange.

SCALE TEST: Each baguette is 5 by 2.5mm; each pomegranate aril is about 9mm, a little larger than one stone; the closed bracelet is a 5.5cm oval, 5mm wide. There is exactly ONE bracelet and ONE clasp; the loop is never broken into two pieces and never has loose ends. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the referent; it dominates by light and isolation, never by being enlarged.

COPY SPACE: The upper left third of the frame is calm, empty ivory plaster, softly lit, for a headline.

LIGHT: soft large window light from the upper left, one soft natural shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a crisp bright edge and a dark rolled edge on every curve and every stone carries internal sparkle and one pure-white catchlight, never flat colour. Honest macro optics: the jewellery is needle-sharp and the scene falls softly out of focus behind it. Real texture everywhere: grain, fibre, dust, believable imperfection, nothing plastic. 

ABSENCE LIST: No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no price tag anywhere in frame. No hands, no people. No second piece of jewellery. No border, no vignette: the photograph fills the frame edge to edge.
